summary: Hotel101 Global Holdings Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a record single-day room revenue of over €100,000 at its Hotel101-Madrid property at 100% occupancy. The filing describes operational performance, property details, and strategic expansion plans but contains no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or abrupt management change. This is a routine operational update for a foreign private issuer.
